standard_prerequisites.name: Duals of perfect complexes
standard_prerequisites.use: R SheafHom(K, K') = K' tensor K-dual for K perfect.

standard_prerequisites.name: Kunneth formula
standard_prerequisites.use: The box-tensor case reduces to the derived-pushforward Kunneth isomorphism.

core_obligations: For K and M perfect, R SheafHom(K, K') = K' tensor^L K-dual and R SheafHom(M, M') = M' tensor^L M-dual.
Perfect complexes are preserved by pullback and by tensor, so R SheafHom(K boxtimes M, K' boxtimes M') = (K' tensor K-dual) boxtimes (M' tensor M-dual).
Apply the carded Kunneth formula to the two tensor factors.
Verify that the identification of the internal Homs produces exactly the map of equation-kunneth-ext; the source omits this check - carry it as an explicit obligation.
proof_roadmap: Dual identifications; box-tensor compatibility; reduction to the carded Kunneth; map-compatibility obligation.
difficulty_reason: A reduction of the Ext form of Kunneth to the pushforward form through perfect duality; the compatibility check is the carried obligation.
